sloka: गतिः वेगः च तेजः च लाघवम् च महाकपे ।पितुः ते सदृशम् वीर मारुतस्य महा ओजसः ॥४-४४-५॥
transliteration: gatiḥ vegaḥ ca tejaḥ ca lāghavam ca mahākape ।pituḥ te sadṛśam vīra mārutasya mahā ojasaḥ ॥4-44-5॥

translations.english: 'O hero, O great monkey in movement, speed, brilliance and quickness you are similar to your mighty father, the Windgod.
